name: Inode exhaustion
description: A spool filesystem has free bytes but almost no remaining inodes.

anomalies.explanation: Disk /var/spool inode usage is 97% (970000/1000000 inodes). Space usage is 40%.
anomalies.recommendation: Find directories with many small files on /var/spool and clean cache, temp, or spool files before inode exhaustion blocks writes.
anomalies.root_cause_hypothesis: Inode pressure is higher than byte pressure.
evidence: Disk /var/spool inode usage is 97% (970000/1000000 inodes). Space usage is 40%.
